user_notes: Sunday bolognese is the quick weeknight version using store-bought fresh spring pasta.
Monday kimbap grain bowls: set aside Elsie's portion BEFORE adding mushrooms; swap in extra caramelized onion or crispy tofu.
Tuesday Babo Pasta is the family staple — keep classic (egg-yolk spinach tagliatelle, brown butter, parm).
Wednesday Tex-Mex grain bowl: chipotle shrimp or chicken, cilantro-lime rice, black beans, charred corn, avocado, pickled red onion.
Thursday black bean burritos with a fresh lime-cilantro cole slaw inside (slaw goes in the burrito for crunch).
Friday white beans + Italian sausage + garlicky sauteed kale, finished with lemon and served with crusty bread — Dan + Elsie cook together (Laura is out with Anne).
Saturday pizza night with four assorted pies — keep variety like recent weeks.

days.name: Sun 05/17
time_constraints: Quick weeknight pace — store-bought fresh pasta keeps it fast.
days.dinner: Quick Bolognese with Fresh Spring Pasta
days.dinner_description: A fast-track bolognese built on a shortcut soffritto, ground beef and pork, tomato, a splash of milk, and store-bought fresh spring pasta. Hearty enough to feel like Sunday but on a Tuesday timeline.
days.dinner_notes: Use fresh pasta from the store; finish pasta in the sauce with a splash of pasta water.

days.name: Mon 05/18
time_constraints: Dan's bootcamp runs until 8 PM — Laura on dinner, components ready to assemble.
days.dinner: Kimbap Grain Bowls with Caramelized Onions and Mushrooms
days.dinner_description: Warm sushi rice topped with deeply caramelized onions, soy-glazed mushrooms, quick-pickled cucumber and carrot, toasted nori strips, sesame, and a fried egg with runny yolk. Gochujang mayo on the side.
days.dinner_notes: Caramelize onions low and slow (30+ min) for maximum sweetness; build bowls so Elsie's portion is set aside before mushrooms go in.
days.elsie_note: Elsie isn't into mushrooms this week — set aside her portion BEFORE adding mushrooms. Bulk it up with extra caramelized onion, an extra fried egg, or crispy cubed tofu so it still feels like a full bowl.

days.name: Tue 05/19
calendar_items: Elsie Swim Practice (Level 4) 6:00 PM - 6:30 PM at 2310 Colts Neck Rd
time_constraints: Dinner has to be ready around 7 PM after swim — Babo Pasta is fast once the dough is made.
days.dinner: Babo Pasta — Egg-Yolk Spinach Tagliatelle with Brown Butter & Parm
days.dinner_description: The family staple. Homemade spinach pasta enriched with egg yolks only, hand-cut into tagliatelle, tossed in foaming brown butter with a snowfall of parm and a few cranks of black pepper.
days.dinner_notes: Make dough Tuesday afternoon during 1:1 breaks; rest in fridge until after swim, then roll & cook in 12 minutes.

days.name: Wed 05/20
time_constraints: Last hot day before the cold front — keep it light and fresh.
days.dinner: Tex-Mex Grain Bowls with Chipotle Shrimp
days.dinner_description: Cilantro-lime rice piled with chipotle-marinated shrimp (or chicken), warm black beans, charred sweet corn, avocado, pickled red onion, crumbled cotija, and a quick chipotle-lime crema.
days.dinner_notes: Char the corn in a dry skillet for smoky depth; marinate shrimp only 15-20 min so they don't toughen.

days.name: Thu 05/21
time_constraints: Cold front arrives — perfect transition meal: still uses Wed leftovers but feels cozy.
days.dinner: Black Bean Burritos with Lime-Cilantro Slaw
days.dinner_description: Burrito-sized flour tortillas wrapped around cumin-spiced black beans, Spanish rice, melty cheese, and a punchy lime-cilantro cabbage slaw tucked inside for crunch. Crisped in a skillet for a golden, shattering exterior.
days.dinner_notes: Toast cumin seeds in the bean pot; crisp the wrapped burritos in a dry skillet for golden seams. Use leftover rice from Wednesday if any.

days.name: Fri 05/22
calendar_items: YAT 4:30 PM - 6:00 PM at 2310 Colts Neck Rd
Laura out with Anne for the evening — Dan + Elsie solo dinner
time_constraints: Cold and rainy after YAT — cozy, hands-on cooking with Elsie.
days.dinner: White Beans & Italian Sausage with Garlicky Sauteed Kale
days.dinner_description: A rustic skillet supper: browned hot Italian sausage crumbled into garlicky kale and creamy cannellini beans, hit with lemon and chili flake, served over thick slabs of toasted crusty bread soaked with the pan juices.
days.dinner_notes: Cold rainy night + Mom out — make this Elsie's cooking lesson: she handles the kale tearing and toast assembly while Dan handles the sausage.

days.name: Sat 05/23
time_constraints: After morning YAT, indoor afternoon — relaxed pizza-making project.
days.dinner_description: Four small pies, each its own personality: classic Margherita, pepperoni-cup with hot honey, a white pie with ricotta-garlic-spinach, and a wildcard veggie or breakfast-for-dinner pie. Cold-fermented dough for blistered, chewy crust.
days.dinner_notes: Start dough Friday night for 24-hour cold ferment; let Elsie design pie #4.
